# ProVA Hiring Tracker

> A single-page hiring pipeline tracker: add candidates, move them through
> stages, rate them, keep interview notes, and search the pipeline. All data
> lives in the visitor's own browser (localStorage); there is no backend and no
> account.

## Pages

- [Hiring Tracker](/): the whole application — pipeline board, list view,
  candidate detail panel with notes and ratings.

## Notes for agents

- The app is client-rendered after hydration; candidate data is per-browser and
  never leaves the device, so there is nothing to crawl beyond the shell.
- Source: https://github.com/davidojo1144/ProVa
